action_items: No backend API-bearing criteria in this matrix; the logo is a static frontend/public/navidha-logo-white.svg served via the shared NavidhaLogo component, so no backend test file was needed.

checks.criterion: Header company logo is larger and renders sharply / Footer company logo is larger and renders sharply
checks.name: header-footer-logo-desktop
checks.evidence: After closing launch-popup: header navidha-logo-image src contains navidha-logo-white.svg, boundingBox 72x72, image fully loaded (naturalWidth>0, complete=true). Footer navidha-brand-mark badge boundingBox ~112x112 with background-color rgb(20,32,46), inner navidha-logo-image 80x80, loaded successfully.

checks.criterion: Logo treatment remains correct on mobile
checks.name: logo-mobile-layout
checks.evidence: At 390x844: header logo boundingBox 72x72 fully within viewport bounds (x>=0, x+width<=390, y>=0, no clipping/overlap). Footer badge boundingBox width==height (circle preserved) and logo horizontally centered within badge (center delta <=2px).

checks.criterion: Logo update does not break navigation or page rendering
checks.name: logo-assets-no-errors
checks.evidence: No requestfailed events for navidha-logo assets; direct GET /navidha-logo-white.svg returned ok()=true; footer-craft-link navigation click succeeded with navbar-home-link still visible afterward, confirming header nav intact.
